summary: Verified consultant role-based auth feature. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (health, auth/me 401, consultants 401, DB schema, seed data, admin/consultant/client role gating via direct DB-seeded sessions, session expiry). Frontend: homepage renders, AuthModal opens with Google + Consultant Sign-in buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 22: ADMIN_EMAIL is hardcoded ('rahulsingh2k10@gmail.com') ignoring the ADMIN_EMAIL value in backend/.env ('bindiya@panchtattwa.com'). Either remove the unused .env key or read ADMIN_EMAIL from os.environ to avoid drift between code and config.

server.py exchange_session() upserts user.role on every login. This correctly re-evaluates role from the consultants table (good), but means manual DB role overrides will be reverted on next login — intentional but worth documenting.
Lifespan calls subprocess pg_ctlcluster on every startup — fine for this preview env, but for production, PG should be managed externally rather than from the FastAPI process.
test_credentials: Google OAuth via Emergent Auth — cannot be exercised end-to-end in automation. Role assignment logic verified by seeding User+UserSession rows directly into PostgreSQL and calling /api/auth/me and /api/consultants with Bearer token. Admin: rahulsingh2k10@gmail.com. Consultant: agrawal.bindiya03@gmail.com.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary users/sessions prefixed with 'TEST_' and clean them up after each test. The 2 production-seeded consultants are left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL is up; consultants table contains rahulsingh2k10@gmail.com (admin) and agrawal.bindiya03@gmail.com (consultant). Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_role_auth.py validate role gating by directly seeding sessions in DB (since OAuth is opaque). All endpoints behave correctly: /api/ → 200, /api/auth/me unauthenticated → 401, /api/consultants requires admin (403 for consultant/client, 200 for admin), /api/bookings requires auth and is filterable by role. Frontend AuthModal shows both google-signin-btn and consultant-signin-btn data-testids; both wire to Emergent OAuth redirect.
